issues.reason: English is thine asserts possession, but Chinese 归你了 adds a new transfer/change of ownership not entailed by that assertion. Archaic pronoun role and sense themselves are sound; retain unchanged pending a separately bound precision amendment.

English keep the cart near the wall does not explicitly require movement or contact; Chinese 靠着墙走 adds both a walking/travel action and a potentially stronger contact relation. The old dialect preposition itself is supported.

English only says that three costumes still needed buttons as of this morning. Chinese 需要缝纽扣 adds a sewing operation not specified by needing buttons; keep the immutable row pending a narrow separately bound translation amendment.

The swaying phrase and scene are sound, but unqualified carriage does not explicitly settle a horse-drawn versus rail subtype whereas Chinese asserts 马车. Retain unchanged pending a bounded amendment either clarifying the intended English vehicle or neutralizing the Chinese subtype.
